assessment: A-level tool-first page for "seo audit checklist" (260/mo, KD 28): the SEO Audit Checklist is the first screen, the 50-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers the main query with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "seo audit checklist" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: Google SEO fundamentals: titles, descriptions, headings, link text, image alt text.
Core Web Vitals thresholds: LCP 2.5 s, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1 at the 75th percentile.
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.

checks: Re-read every factual claim against the cited primary sources, fetched on 2026-10-24 (3 sources listed on the page); unverifiable statements were removed or reworded before publishing.
content-lint passed with no errors: 429 words, 2 Pexels images, 2 inline source links, 3 internal links, 4 FAQs, 4 H2 sections.
Title/H1, secondary-keyword H2s and meta description match the locked three-round plan in docs/seo-v2/final-table.json.
Rendered on the local build at a 375 px mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth equals the viewport width).
Recomputed every figure quoted from AEOeye Technical SEO Baseline (391 sites, 2026-10-24) from the raw files in /public/resources.
Exercised the interactive 40-item checklist in the browser on the local build at desktop and 375 px widths.
